plain: Estimate the error bar by re-drawing your own items at random, many times, and seeing how much the number moves.
eli5: Pull sweets from the same bag again and again, putting each back, and see how much the count jumps around.
technical: Efron (1979): resample the n items with replacement B times, recompute the statistic, and take the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles (percentile interval). No variance formula needed; can be poor for very small n.
